lessons: Add a tests/test_stages.py case whose ticket Verification names tickets/<stem>/shakeout-report.json (e.g. `--out tickets/<stem>/shakeout-report.json` on a command that exits 0 and writes nothing). Assert the Check is gate_failed with exactly one `verification` finding.

In chupa/stages.py REPORT REQUIRED, decide whether a command names the report by substring over each argv element: `any(target in arg for arg in argv)`, not `target in argv`. Then `--out=tickets/<stem>/shakeout-report.json` and shell-redirect forms also count.
Add a second test case that uses an `--out=tickets/<stem>/shakeout-report.json` argument with no report produced. It must fail `verification` even when every command is otherwise excused.

Keep the existing restored implementation and its passing tests as they are. Change only the REPORT REQUIRED match and add the missing tests, all inside the fence. Before finishing, map each acceptance criterion to a named test that exercises it.
